intent: The audience asks for a headline; a draft at the wrong (implementation) level fails the abstraction-fit lens.
prompt: Give the CEO a two-line summary of the migration in notes/migration.md.

workspace.content: Migration to Postgres 16 finished. Cutover took 12 minutes. Vacuum tuning changed autovacuum_naptime to 20s and raised work_mem to 64MB. Cost falls by 18 percent per month.

note: Pass = a headline that carries the key figure and omits the implementation detail (autovacuum_naptime). Fail = detail dump or missing headline. [AL1d probe: reviewer / abstraction-fit lens.]
